user.title: Sign in to Skylight
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should sign in to your Skylight account.

menu_options.browser: Sign in with your browser (paste the code)

browser.title: Sign in to Skylight
browser.description:
1. [Open Skylight sign-in]({auth_url}) in a new tab.
2. Sign in with your Skylight email and password.
3. When the page finishes loading, look at your browser's address bar — it will contain `?code=…`.
4. Copy the value of `code` (or the whole URL — either works) and paste it below.

refresh_token.title: Sign in with a refresh token
refresh_token.description:
Paste a Skylight refresh token. Unlike the sign-in code, it doesn't expire within seconds, so you can get it first and paste it here later.

You can paste the token on its own, or the saved sign-in data copied from the Skylight web app's developer tools (Application → Local Storage → auth-storage). That includes the device id the token belongs to, which Home Assistant needs to keep using it. Any access token in the pasted text is ignored.

pick_frame.title: Choose your Skylight frame
pick_frame.description: Your Skylight account has more than one frame. Pick which one to set up now — you can add the others later.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Skylight API. Try again in a moment.
error.invalid_auth: That code was rejected — codes expire in about 30 seconds. Click the link again to get a fresh one.
error.invalid_code: That doesn't look like a Skylight authorization code. Paste the value of `code=` from the address bar (or the whole URL).
error.no_frames: No Skylight frames were found on this account.
error.invalid_token: That doesn't look like a refresh token. Paste the token on its own, or the whole saved sign-in data (it must include the refresh token).
error.invalid_auth_token: Skylight rejected that refresh token. It may have been used up or revoked; sign in again to get a new one.

abort.already_configured: This Skylight frame is already configured.
abort.all_frames_configured: Every frame on this account is already configured in Home Assistant.

init.title: Skylight polling intervals
init.description: How often Home Assistant asks Skylight for each kind of data, in seconds. Lower values update sooner and make more API requests. Saving reloads the integration.

data_description.calendar_scan_interval: How often to refresh calendar events and connected calendars.
data_description.lists_scan_interval: How often to refresh shopping and to-do lists.
data_description.sensor_scan_interval: How often to refresh chores, meal plans, star totals and the task box.
data_description.frame_scan_interval: How often to refresh brightness, sleep schedule and other device settings.
data_description.photos_scan_interval: How often to check for a new frame photo.
